purpose: Defines the 200-byte IMS pending authorization detail child segment PAUTDTL1 (one per authorization request), copied under 01 PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS and, in COPAUS2C, inside the LINK commarea. It carries the descending date/time key, the original request data (card, type, amounts, merchant), the decision (response code and reason, approved amount), the match status lifecycle and fraud flags. COPAUA0C inserts it, COPAUS0C/COPAUS1C display it, COPAUS1C/COPAUS2C update its fraud fields, CBPAUP0C deletes expired ones, and the unload/load utilities copy it.

key_fields.name: PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY
key_fields.meaning: 8-byte segment key (PAUT9CTS) composed of complemented date and time so newest sorts first.

key_fields.name: PA-AUTH-DATE-9C
key_fields.meaning: 99999 minus YYDDD processing date (set by COPAUA0C, reversed by CBPAUP0C).

key_fields.name: PA-AUTH-ORIG-DATE
key_fields.meaning: Original request date YYMMDD from the MQ request.

key_fields.name: PA-AUTH-RESP-CODE
key_fields.meaning: Response code; '00' approved, otherwise declined ('05' from COPAUA0C).

key_fields.name: PA-MATCH-STATUS
key_fields.meaning: Lifecycle: P pending, D declined, E pending expired, M matched with transaction.

key_fields.name: PA-AUTH-FRAUD
key_fields.meaning: Fraud flag: F confirmed, R removed, space none.

key_fields.name: PA-FRAUD-RPT-DATE
key_fields.meaning: Date the fraud action was recorded (MM/DD/YY from COPAUS2C).

observations.text: Computed length is 200 bytes, matching CHILD-SEG-REC PIC X(200) in the unload/load programs.
88-levels PA-MATCH-PENDING-EXPIRED ('E') and PA-MATCHED-WITH-TRAN ('M') are never set by any B01 program; CBPAUP0C deletes expired details instead of marking them 'E'.
Field name PA-MERCHANT-CATAGORY-CODE is misspelled (CATAGORY); the same spelling is used in DB2 AUTHFRDS.
